test_encode_text: test the text_video_gpt model by encoding a text prompt into input tokens
test_encode_video: test the text_video_gpt model by encoding a random video tensor into latent tokens
test_decode_video: test the text_video_gpt model by decoding latent tokens back into a video tensor
test_lookup: test the text_video_gpt model lookup method for both input and output modalities
test_forward_gpt_pretrained: test the text_video_gpt forward pass with a pretrained GPT checkpoint
